title: Drew Allar "excited" to learn from Aaron Rodgers

sources.title: Drew Allar "excited" to learn from Aaron Rodgers
sources.description: Drew Allar has some familiarity with the West Coast offense, but the Steelers rookie quarterback doesn't know nearly as much about Mike McCarthy's offense as Aaron Rodgers.
